# CEDARS

CEDARS (Carbon, Energy Diagnostics and Reporting for Sustainability) is a free, open-source, browser-based platform for sustainability assessment and reporting across radiology departments and medical AI.

Canonical site: https://cedarsleaf.com/
Source code: https://github.com/takinci/cedars

## Primary workflows

- Profile: document the current Radiology Department or AI Model & Informatics assessment. Department Profile follows Context → Workflow → Clinical AI (optional) → Result (EcoLabel); AI Profile follows Context → Training → Deployment → Result (EcoLabel).
- Decision Workspace: model prospective changes without overwriting the current Profile; Improvement Potential remains separate from the current Footprint Score.
- Report & Share: carry forward the same Department EcoLabel or AI Research EcoLabel, then review Methods/evidence and save or share the assessment.

## EcoLabel method

- CEDARS uses one **EcoLabel family with two assessment paths** and a shared 0–100 / 1–5-leaf reporting format.
- **Radiology Department:** the EcoLabel Score is reference-adjusted operational energy. Modeled current imaging/PACS/reporting energy is compared with a CEDARS service reference matched to the represented fleet and physical imaging workload. Score 50 means at the matched reference, not the 50th percentile.
- **AI Research EcoLabel:** the EcoLabel Score remains lifecycle carbon intensity when the required basis is available: amortized training plus recurring inference carbon per study/use on the documented v1 research anchors.
- Absolute environmental impact remains separately reported. The Department operational-energy score does not improve merely because the local electricity grid is lower carbon.
- Department Context is ordered as local energy/reporting → optional illustrative quick-start → Practice & service context. Practice size, sites, setting, location, service hours, and scanner-operating/mixed/teleradiology status are carried with the service reference for like-for-like interpretation. The current numerical energy reference is driven by the represented equipment and physical workload; practice type itself does not create bonus points.
- Decision Workspace is prospective and remains separate from the current EcoLabel.
- The public **EcoLabel Method** page presents the two paths visually; technical formulas, assumptions, and future calibration are collapsed below the infographic.
## Key topics

Radiology sustainability; medical imaging environmental footprint; medical AI energy and carbon footprint; healthcare decarbonization; radiology energy use; AI inference and training energy; cloud compute; water use; clinical AI; sustainability interventions; environmental reporting; EcoLabel; planetary health; cost; clinical care.

## Important notes

CEDARS is a research and estimation tool. Literature defaults are editable and local or measured values should be used when available. Normal calculator use remains browser-local; research contribution is an explicit optional action.
